title: What If Asta Was Reborn With All His Memories and Anti-Magic? | Part 1
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made what-if. Black Clover is created by Yuki Tabata. Original code-drawn artwork; no footage or artwork from the manga or anime is used. Full manga spoilers.

reference.title: What If Naruto Was Reborn with All His Memories and Powers? | Part 1

beats.say: Hage Village. The Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony.
Hundreds of books lift off the shelves, and drift down to their new owners.
One boy gets a {four}*four-leaf* clover. The grimoire of legends.
And one boy gets {none}*nothing*.
The crowd laughs. {again}Just like last time.
But this time... {smile}Asta is *smiling*.
Because his grimoire isn't on these shelves.
It's been hidden under a church floorboard... for {eight}*eight years*.
This is not the Asta you know. This one already lived the {whole}whole story.
Every {w1}war. Every {w2}funeral. Every {w3}traitor's name.
Then he woke up on a church doorstep — as a newborn — with all of it still in his head.
He knows {k1}who destroys the kingdom. He knows {k2}which captain is lying. He knows {k3}the name of the devil behind everything.
And he can't tell a {single}*single soul*.
Because in the Clover Kingdom, a boy who knows too much isn't called a hero. He's called a {devil}*devil*. And devils get {exec}*executed*.
Start at the end. Somewhere in the final war, Asta's story... {stop}stops.
And then — {cry}crying. His own.
October fourth. Hage Village. The edge of the kingdom, in the shadow of a demon's skull.
Two babies on a church doorstep. One of them is {yuno}Yuno. The other is a {war}grown warrior, in a body that can't hold its own head up.
So let's be precise about what came back with him. Memories: {m}all of them. Body: {b}six pounds. Mana: {z}zero — same as before. He was born without it, and no memory changes that.
And Anti-Magic? {p}That's problem number one.
Problem one: Anti-Magic was never *his*.
It doesn't live in Asta's body. It lives in a devil named {liebe}Liebe —
and Liebe is sealed inside a ragged {book}five-leaf grimoire, gathering dust in the wall of the {tower}Grimoire Tower.
{a}No book, no devil. {b}No devil, no Anti-Magic.
The power in the title? He has to go and earn it. {again}Again.
Problem two: memories aren't *muscles*.
He remembers how to read Ki — the sixth sense Captain Yami drilled into him.
He remembers Zetten, from the Land of the Sun. He remembers {swords}every sword form he ever bled for.
But knowing how to swing a slab of iron taller than you are... doesn't help when you can't {walk}walk.
Problem three is the one that gets him *killed*.

shot.title: THE BOOK IS A DEATH SENTENCE

beats.say: A five-leaf grimoire means a devil. The first time around, the Magic Parliament put him on trial just for carrying one — and that was *after* he'd helped save the kingdom.
A child with a devil's book and a head full of state secrets? That's not a trial. That's an {x}*execution*.
So: {a}no power. {b}No body. {c}No allies. {d}Fifteen years on the clock. {go}@asta: This time... nobody dies on schedule.
First, he does the hardest thing a shonen protagonist has ever done. He {shh}shuts up.
For three years, the loudest kid in the Clover Kingdom plays a perfectly normal baby.
But Ki doesn't need muscles. Ki is {b}breath. {p}Presence. The life-force of everything around you.
So before he can even walk, he's lying in the dark, reading the whole church by its breathing.
Father Orsi, {o}snoring. Sister Lily, {l}awake again. And in the next crib — a quiet, steady presence he'd know {y}anywhere.
By five, he trains. In the original timeline he did this too — every single day, with no idea what any of it was *for*.
Now, every rep has a target. He knows exactly what the Demon-Slayer Sword demands. He knows exactly what his body has to {become}become.
So he carves a plank to the same length... and he {grow}grows into it.
And this is where the timeline first pushes {back}*back*.
A night you may remember. A drunk grabs little Yuno's pendant.
In canon, Asta charges in, gets beaten half to death, and refuses to stay down — and that's the night crybaby Yuno decides to become the Wizard King.
This Asta has fought devils. He reads the man's Ki before the fist even moves. He knows *precisely* how to win.
And he still {lose}loses. Because he weighs {w}*forty pounds*.
So he does the only thing he can. He gets back up. {a}Again. {b}And again.
The vow still happens. But Yuno is a genius, and geniuses notice things.
Asta moved before every punch. Like he already {knew}*knew*.
From that night, Yuno doesn't just have a rival. He has a *mystery*. And he starts training years ahead of schedule to solve it.

shot.title: YUNO
shot.detail: Starts training years ahead of canon — to solve Asta.

beats.say: Age seven. Asta can't wait any longer — and here's why.
Every year that book sits in the tower, Liebe sits inside it. {w1}Alone. {w2}In the dark. {w3}Hating.
Because Asta knows the devil's whole story now. Liebe was born at the very bottom of the underworld, with no magic at all — so weak, he {slip}slipped through the gate into our world.
Humans hunted him. {one}One woman took him in. Called him her son. Her name was {l}Licita.
When the devil king Lucifero tried to claw his way into our world through Liebe's body, Licita fought back with her bare hands. {kill}It killed her.
With her last breath, she sealed Liebe inside a five-leaf grimoire — to keep him {safe}safe.
That woman had another son. One she had to leave on a church doorstep — because her own body drained the life out of anyone she held.
The first time, it took years — and a fight to the death — to learn that. This time, he walks into the tower {know}already knowing.

right.label: THIS TIMELINE
right.sub: He already knows who is in the book

beats.say: Midnight. A seven-year-old breaks into the Grimoire Tower.
The books don't react. They never did, for him. He climbs past ten thousand glowing spines to the one that doesn't glow — the one wedged into the wall itself.
He doesn't try to take it. He sits down in front of it. And he says one word.
{say}*Licita.*
The book tears itself {open}*open*.
Liebe comes out swinging — because this is all he ever wanted. A body with no magic. An empty house to move into. And this one is seven years old.
Asta can't win this fight. He doesn't try. Pinned to the floor, claws at his throat, he just keeps {talk}talking.
About the woman who gave a devil a name. About the day she died. Things only her son could know.
Liebe's voice cracks. {q1}@liebe: How do you know her? {q2}@asta: Because she was my mother too.

b.text: Because she was my mother too.

beats.say: The first time, Asta beat Liebe — and then offered his hand. This time he loses, and offers it {any}anyway.
No master. No servant. Brothers — ten years ahead of schedule.

shot.title: LIEBE
shot.detail: A contract between equals, at age seven.

beats.say: But the timeline has rules. Asta finally draws the Demon-Slayer Sword...
...and it slams into the {thud}floor. He can't lift it. {jk}@liebe: Pathetic. Eat more.
And Devil Union? In a child's body, it lasts about a {beat}heartbeat before it starts tearing him apart.
So the grimoire goes under a floorboard in the church.
And for eight more years, two brothers train in secret — one in the yard, one in the book. {lb}@liebe: Again, short-stuff. Again.
Which brings us back to where we started. Age fifteen. The tower.
Yuno gets his four-leaf — some things, destiny doesn't negotiate.
Asta gets nothing. And {smile}smiles.
Outside, someone is waiting. {name}Revchi. A disgraced ex–Magic Knight with chain magic, here to steal a four-leaf grimoire and sell it.
In canon, this is Asta's worst moment. Beaten. Told he has no magic and never will. Seconds from giving up — and {come}that's when the grimoire comes.
This time, Asta felt Revchi's Ki from the other side of the village. {lb}@liebe: Chain guy. Tower. Go.
Chains wrap the Demon-Slayer Sword — and stop {x}*existing*.
{swing}One swing. It's over before Yuno can open his book.
{p}Problem: that is not how a boy who got his grimoire ten seconds ago fights.
Yuno looks at the sword. Then at Asta. And he asks the one question Asta has been dreading for fifteen years.
{q}@yuno: How long have you had that?

shot.text: How long have you had that?

beats.say: Asta doesn't answer. Yuno doesn't push. {q}@yuno: Fine. Keep your secret. I'll become the Wizard King anyway.

shot.quote: Keep your secret. I'll become the Wizard King anyway.

beats.say: The rivalry survives. But this Yuno isn't chasing a loudmouth with a dream. He's chasing someone who is hiding the truth about the world.

shot.title: THE RIVALRY
shot.detail: Yuno knows Asta is hiding something — and trains to surpass it.

beats.say: Six months later. The Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Nine captains, looking down from the balcony.
And Asta looks back up — and sees what no one else in that arena can.
William Vangeance. Captain of the Golden Dawn. The most trusted man in the kingdom after the Wizard King —
— sharing his body with {p}Patolli, the elf who leads the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

shot.name: PATOLLI
shot.role: LEADER  ·  EYE OF THE MIDNIGHT SUN

beats.say: Gueldre. Captain of the Purple Orcas. {sell}Selling the kingdom's secrets.
And behind both of them — five hundred years deep — a devil named {z}Zagred, who has been writing this tragedy since before the first Wizard King.
He knows all of it. He can prove {none}*none* of it.
So when his turn comes, he hides almost everything. No mana. No noble name. And just like before — not one captain {want}wants him.
Except {one}one.
Yami Sukehiro. The man who taught him Ki.
And Ki is the problem. Because Yami reads people the same way Asta does. And what he reads off this fifteen-year-old... isn't a kid. It's a {vet}*veteran*. {lb}@liebe: He's onto you.
Yami just grins. {q}@yami: I don't care what you're hiding, kid. Join the Black Bulls.

shot.text: I don't care what you're hiding, kid. Join the Black Bulls.

beats.say: And Asta says yes. Not out of nostalgia. Out of {s}*strategy*.
Because he knows what the Black Bulls really are.
Finral — a door to anywhere in the kingdom.
Noelle — a royal with an ocean of mana, and no control... yet.

shot.name: NOELLE
shot.line: An ocean of mana. No control — yet.

beats.say: Vanessa — magic that can rewrite fate itself.
A hideout that's secretly {alive}alive. A vice-captain watching from the {shadow}shadows.

shot.name: THE BASE  +  THE SHADOW
shot.line: A living hideout. A vice-captain nobody sees.

beats.say: And a little black bird, about to land on his head — who has been keeping the kingdom's oldest secret for {yrs}five hundred years.
It's not the worst squad in the kingdom. It's the only one that can win the war he {rem}remembers.

lines: THE ONLY ONE THAT CAN WIN.

beats.say: So now he's in. He has the {a}sword, the {b}brother, the {c}squad. And a {clock}clock.
Because the Eye of the Midnight Sun is about to {e1}hit the capital. A captain is about to {e2}lose his arm. And the plan to resurrect the elves is {e3}already in motion.
Move too {loud}loud — accuse a captain with no proof — and he's the devil-boy on trial.
Move too {slow}slow, and everyone he came back to save dies on schedule.
There's one obvious answer. One man who loves strange magic. Who listened to him last time. Who could end all of this with a word.
Julius Novachrono. The Wizard King.
Asta gets as far as the door.
And he {stop}stops. Because of the last thing he remembers. The final secret — from the very end of the story.
Inside Julius, there is a second soul. {name}Lucius Zogratis. The final enemy.
A man who can see the future — and Asta is the one thing he could never {see}foresee.
If Lucius learns that someone in this timeline already knows how it ends...
Asta turns to leave.
The door {open}opens.
{q}@julius: Asta, right? The boy with no magic. I've been hoping to meet you.

shot.text: Asta, right? The boy with no magic. I've been hoping to meet you.

beats.say: {lb}@liebe: Asta. Why does he have {hb}two heartbeats? @n: Julius is smiling. The question is... {which}which one?
Part two: the capital burns early. If you want it... you know what to do.
